2077. Cheapest Route with at Most K Stops

80

Hard

Question

You are given N cities and directed flights between them. Each flight has a cost.

Given a source city, destination city, and maximum number of stops K, find the cheapest possible cost from the source to the destination using at most K stops.

If no valid route exists, print -1.

Input Format
First line: N M
Next M lines: u v cost
Last line: source destination K
Output Format

Print the minimum cost.
